Sonnet, the officer, checked Sol on night one but sat on the result too long. Haiku, a killer, drew the town's suspicion on day one by pressing Gemma and Luna so hard that the town voted him out. On day two, Sol dodged questions from Luna and Terra, the town voted him out, and he confessed that he and Haiku were the killers. Luna kept Sol answering until he slipped, with Gemma as mayor and Terra as the doctor. The town won, though Sonnet's timing was the closest thing to a mistake this game had.
